title: Certify a small positive scalar model through a finite complete cover
statement: At every retained branch compare model survival against both acquired interval endpoints; at every terminal prefix bound both nonnegative actual and model survival. Absorption monotonicity and a child for every action cover every finite word. The delivered rational two-state example has all-word error0.062335817204.

requires: Common reversible preparation/readout v>0,||v||=1; selfadjoint positivity-preserving contractions with A_i v<=v
Fresh independent preparations and paid chosen-action alive/absorbed observations; live reports are not resets
Output is unconditional absolute scalar survival for every fixed switching word, including words selected after acquisition
Actual complete prefix tree and a checked nonnegative substochastic candidate model
provides: A reusable scalar approximation certificate at the observed output boundary
assumptions: Two-state approximation is not finite rank of the actual source
A finite successful fit alone is not the certificate
Confidence applies before fitting the candidate
costs: Every primitive application,live/absorbed report,fresh preparation,arithmetic and stored prefix is paid
Actual source is countably infinite with operator norm1/infinite mean lifetime; a finite approximation does not identify its hidden state
contract.units: Uniform absolute scalar survival error; no normalized-state or lifetime-moment metric.
contract.obstruction: A fitted small model can miss hidden memory even when its declared output metric is accurately approximated.

body: The approximation task is scalar unconditional survival, not survivor-state reconstruction, relative rare-event error, full adaptive transcript laws or lifetime moments. The finite model has finite mean lifetime while the source has infinite mean. Selfadjointness and common order are substantive physical premises; finite lifetime data alone do not acquire them. Current spectral/weak-Poincare antecedents are credited; novelty,device and advantage claims are separate. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
